description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called 'GeneralSettings' for the macOS OpenClaw application. It handles user interface components for application settings related to gateway configuration, remote connection management, health checks, and diagnostic controls within the app.

classes.name: RemoteStatus
classes.description: An enum representing the current status of the remote gateway connection, including idle, checking, success, and failure states.

methods.name: refreshGatewayStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously checks the current environment status of the gateway and updates the 'gatewayStatus' property.

methods.name: testRemote
methods.description: Runs a remote gateway probe and updates the 'remoteStatus' based on the result.

methods.name: revealLogs
methods.description: Attempts to locate and reveal the application logs in the Finder; shows an alert if logs are not found.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Sets the preferred gateway based on discovery results and updates the UI state accordingly.
